dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple light-grey ring-shaped structures with thin, high-contrast perimeters and darker centers; edges are irregular and slightly scalloped, notably in the upper-mid dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, light-grey amorphous clusters scattered across the lateral midline, concentrated between the prominent ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A central group of four primary macro-annuli form a trapezoidal spatial relationship on the mid-dorsal surface, with smaller blobs extending in a linear chain toward the posterior end.
